title: Impact of Hospital Proximity on Mortality Rates
research_question: Does the intensity of healthcare received affect mortality rates? Specifically, we investigate whether living closer to a hospital increases the intensity of care and subsequently impacts mortality outcomes.
data_description: The dataset includes 500 individuals with columns: y (mortality rate), x (care intensity), z (distance to nearest hospital), and controls (age, gender, pre-existing conditions). The variable z serves as an instrument for x to explore its causal impact on y.
